description: This file defines functions and classes related to leak checking behavior in memory sanitizers such as LeakSanitizer (LSan) and AddressSanitizer (ASan). It includes functions to detect sanitizer presence, ignore specific leaks, report leaks, and manage leak checking scope.

classes.name: LeakCheckDisabler
classes.description: A helper class that disables leak checking within its scope, preventing reported leaks for objects allocated during its lifetime.

methods.name: IgnoreLeak
methods.description: Template function that instructs the leak sanitizer to ignore leak warnings on the specified object pointer.

methods.name: LeakCheckDisabler
methods.description: Constructor and destructor that disable and re-enable leak checking within a scope.
